flatten_state_dict: flatten a nested state dict into a top-level dictionary with dot-separated keys and a path mapping
unflatten_state_dict: restore a nested state dict from a flattened dictionary using the path mapping
traverse_state_dict: traverse a nested state dict visiting each leaf element with its object path
set_element: set a value at a nested object path inside a dictionary structure
build_flatten_state_dict: build a flattened state dict and path mapping from a nested dict for distributed checkpoint operations
